declarations.description:
Text that turns into a field when clicked: the edit-in-place pattern of Notion titles, Airtable cells and Linear
issue fields. The read view is a button showing the value (or the `placeholder`), with a pencil on hover. Clicking it,
or pressing Enter or Space on it, swaps in an input with the text selected. **Enter** commits, **Escape** cancels and
focus returns to the read view; with `multiline` the editor is a textarea and **Ctrl/⌘+Enter** commits. Leaving the
field commits by default (`blur-action`), and `controls` adds save and cancel buttons.

Any control can replace the built-in input through the `editor` slot: put a `c2-select`, a `c2-number-input` or a
native `<select>` there. Its `value` is set from the inline edit when editing starts, its `change` event commits
(bubbling or not: it is heard on the control itself),
and the read view shows the label of the option whose `value` matches (or `formatValue`). A slotted control's own
`input` and `change` events stay inside the inline edit; the host fires its own once the value is committed.

`value` always holds the committed value. Each commit that changes it fires `edit-commit` first, which is
cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to reject the draft and keep the editor open (validation, a failed save).
Then `value` updates and `input` and `change` fire. The element is form-associated: `name` submits the committed
value and `required` refuses to commit an empty one.

The host exposes its state as custom states: `:state(editing)`, `:state(empty)`, `:state(invalid)`,
`:state(read-only)` and `:state(disabled)`. Give the host a `width` (or `display: block`) to make the read view
and the field fill a cell; otherwise it sizes to its text.
declarations.name: InlineEdit

cssProperties.description: Smallest width of the read view and the field, so an empty value stays clickable.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit--min-width

cssProperties.description: Text colour. Inherited from the page when unset.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit--color

cssProperties.description: Inherited from the page when unset, so the element fits a heading or a table cell.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit--font-size

cssProperties.description: Read view background under the pointer.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__hover--background

cssProperties.description: Focus ring of the read view and the buttons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__focus--outline

cssProperties.description: Space between the value and the pencil.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__edit-icon--gap

cssProperties.description: Pencil opacity at rest. Set `1` to always show it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__edit-icon--opacity

cssProperties.description: Pencil opacity on hover and keyboard focus.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__edit-icon__hover--opacity

cssProperties.description: Field border while the draft is refused (`required` and empty); drawn as an outline around a slotted `editor`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__editor__error--border

cssProperties.description: Space between the field and the save and cancel buttons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-inline-edit__controls--gap

slots.description: A control used instead of the built-in input while editing. It must expose `value` and fire `change` on itself when a choice is made (it need not bubble), and carry its own accessible name (`aria-label`): `label` names only the built-in field and the read view. It gets `aria-invalid` while a `required` draft is refused.
slots.name: editor

slots.description: Content shown in the read view instead of the value text, e.g. a badge. Update it yourself on `change`.
slots.name: preview

slots.description: Replaces the pencil shown next to the value on hover and focus.
slots.name: edit-icon

slots.description: Replaces the check mark of the save button (`controls`).
slots.name: save-icon

slots.description: Replaces the cross of the cancel button (`controls`).
slots.name: cancel-icon

members.name: value
members.description: The committed value. Typing only changes the draft; `value` updates when the draft is committed.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown in the read view and the field while the value is empty.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the built-in field and of the read view, e.g. `Project name`. A slotted `editor` needs its own.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. The committed value is submitted under it.

members.name: formatValue
members.description:
Turns the value into the read view's text, e.g. a currency or a date. Without it, the read view shows the label
of the matching option in a slotted `editor`, or else the value itself. Returning `undefined` falls back to that.

members.name: multiline
members.description: Edits in a textarea: Enter adds a line, Ctrl/⌘+Enter commits, and the read view keeps line breaks.

members.name: activation
members.description: What enters edit mode from the read view: `click` (default), `dblclick`, or `none` (only `edit()`). Enter and Space always work in `click` and `dblclick`.

members.name: blurAction
members.description: What leaving the field does: `commit` (default; a refused draft stays open with its text), `cancel`, or `none` (stay in edit mode).

members.name: controls
members.description: Shows save and cancel buttons next to the field while editing.

members.name: selectOnEdit
members.description: Selects the whole text when the built-in field opens. Set `select-on-edit="false"` to put the caret at the end.

members.name: required
members.description: Refuses to commit an empty draft: the field stays open and is marked invalid.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum number of characters, forwarded to the built-in field.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Shows the value without the edit affordance.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables editing and dims the element.

members.name: editing
members.description:
Whether the editor is open. Settable: `true` opens it with the committed value and focuses it, `false` closes it
without committing. No events fire. An element that renders with `editing` already set opens without taking
focus; call `focus()` to move it there.

members.name: markedEditor
members.description: The slotted editor this element marked `aria-invalid`, so the mark can be removed again.

members.name: defaultValue
members.description: The value as it stood when the element was created or last reset by its form.

members.name: listenedEditor
members.description: The slotted editor whose `input` and `change` this element listens to.

members.name: swapping
members.description: True while a render swaps the read view and the editor, so focus leaving a removed node is not reported.

members.name: draftValue
members.description: The text being edited. Equal to `value` outside edit mode.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: edit
members.description: Opens the editor with the current value. Does nothing while disabled or read-only.

members.name: commit
members.description:
Commits the draft. Returns `false` when it was refused (`required` and empty, or `edit-commit` was canceled), in
which case the editor stays open.

members.name: cancel
members.description: Closes the editor and throws the draft away.

members.name: focusInside
members.description: Whether focus should come back to the read view after the editor closes.

members.name: listenEditor
members.description:
Listens on the slotted control itself rather than on its slot, so a `change` that does not bubble is still heard
and the control's own events stop before they reach the host.

members.name: displayText
members.description: The text the read view shows for the committed value.

members.name: handleInnerFocusout
members.description:
Focus moving inside the element (read view to editor, editor to read view) is not focus leaving it: the read view
or the field being removed by a mode switch, or a move between the slotted editor and the shadow tree, stops here
so `focusout` listeners on the host (a form library marking the control touched) only see the user leave.

members.name: keepFocus
members.description: Keeps focus in the field while a control button is pressed, so blur does not commit first.

events.name: edit-start
events.description: Fired before the editor opens. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the read view.

events.name: edit-commit
events.description: Fired when a changed draft is committed, before `value` updates. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the editor open with the draft.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after a commit changed `value`, right after `input`.

events.name: edit-cancel
events.description: Fired when editing ends without committing (Escape, the cancel button, or blur with `blur-action="cancel"`).
